offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based software and integrated payment processing that help small and mid-sized service businesses run operations, including scheduling, invoicing, customer engagement and payments. Sells mainly on subscription to service businesses in home services, health services and fitness/wellness.

primary_products.value: field service management software; practice management software; marketing and customer engagement software; billing and invoicing software

primary_services.value: integrated payment processing; customer support and implementation

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized service businesses such as home service contractors, healthcare practices, fitness and wellness studios

end_markets.value: home services; health services; fitness and wellness; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software subscriptions for business management platforms; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees on customer transactions

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts SaaS platforms sold to service businesses; financial intermediary: embedded payment processing for customers' payments

geography_served.value: global: primarily United States, with customers in Canada, UK, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: vertical SaaS across home services, health services and fitness/wellness with shared payments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: inside sales teams selling to businesses; online: website-led digital marketing and self-signup; partners / resellers: integration and referral partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment processing rules (card networks, PCI) and health data privacy such as HIPAA
